media.description:
It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it’s amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they’ve never felt more alive.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara and his twin sister, Sawa, are playing Actual Magic, a brand-new virtual reality MMORPG, when it suddenly begins fusing with the real world. Amid all the chaos and confusion, it becomes clear that death is lurking around every corner, including when Yuuma runs into his classmate Sumika. Before, she was one of the cutest girls in his class, but she’s since undergone a terrible metamorphosis—into one of the game’s horrifying monsters! From the author of Sword Art Online and Accel World comes a story beyond VR and AR, where gaming and reality are one and the same…and staying alive is just the beginning!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.romaji: Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen 2nd Season Part 2

media.description: The second cour of the second season of Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen.

Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title.romaji: Mouse Cursor de Genjitsu wo Sousa Dekiru You ni Natta node, Onnanoko wo Ippai Click Shimasu
title.english: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I'm Gonna Click Away On The Girls!

media.description:
What if you could control reality with a mouse cursor?

One day during class, Takumi— an otaku — notices his mouse cursor has sprung out of the screen.

Panicked, he asks his childhood friend Mone, sitting next to him, to take a look, only to be brushed off...

Once Takumi realizes he could actually control it himself, he uses the mouse cursor— visible only to him— to slip it in between Mone's clothes and starts clicking away...

Here's Japan’s (probably) first new genre of romcom, "Clicking Away at a Gyaru Who's Mean to Otakus with a Mouse Cursor"!

(Source: Official Site)

Note: Episode 1 receives an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on September 11th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.

Two young boys... the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom - a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region.

The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return.

Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war.

The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

Some magical girls fight. Others do not. Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, which exists unbeknownst to the rest of the world, magical girls are each granted a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced to take part in a mysterious virtual game together with 16 unfamiliar magical girls, each with her own distinctive personality. It was supposed to be a safe training exercise designed to improve their magical abilities. But instead, it marks the beginning of a carefully orchestrated nightmare - a forbidden trial. A new Magical Girl Raising Project has begun.

(Source: OceanVeil)

title.romaji: Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi
title.english: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom

media.description:
At the heart of a continent of eight kingdoms lies the Marronnier Kingdom. Its general, Baribara, has seven sons, each with a unique gift and serving as a knight commander. Bound by a single noble cause of heroically rescuing a princess someday, the brothers set out as goodwill ambassadors to the seven neighboring kingdoms. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unknown lands?

(Source: Amazon Prime Video)

The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Urban legends come to life…Everyone’s heard an urban legend before, but few have ever come face-to-face with one. These phenomena are everywhere, existing in the shadows of reality. More and more of them have been appearing in the wake of the faceless kid sighted all over Japan. If you see her or one of the urban legends she brings―pray the boy in the red hood finds you before it’s too late. You won’t stand a chance on your own. But with his help, you may just live to see another day…

(Source: Yen Press)

title.romaji: Hitozukiai ga Nigate na Miboujin no Yukionna-san to Noroi no Yubiwa
title.english: The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring

media.description:
Widowed Snow Woman Meets Young Man...
It's the modern world, where humans, yokai, and various other races coexist...
One day, Satoru—who works as the apartment manager—ends up angering his secret crush, Mifuyu, a snow woman who lives in the same building.
Eager to make amends, he uses a mysterious ring that is said to help in communicating with yokai. However, he finds himself hotly pursued by Mifuyu, who has suddenly become extremely forward.
A socially aloof widowed snow woman and a young adult male who wants to support her. What awaits them at the end of their repeated physical encounters, fueled by the ring’s power…?

(Source: Official Website)

Note: Episode 1 receives an advance distribution on AnimeFesta on September 11th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.

On her way home from school one day, Noriko is unexpectedly plunged into a strange and extraordinary fantasy world. Her troubles compound exponentially when she is rescued and befriended by a handsome young man by the name of Izark. He may be brave and courageous, but inside Izark lurks the darkest evil imaginable. And according to an ancient prophecy, Noriko possesses the power to unleash that evil. Now, inexorably bound together, these two unlikely allies must navigate a world both wondrous and hostile.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title.romaji: Oji-san wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki.

media.description:
By day, Mitsutaka Oji is the handsome, dependable boss everyone admires. By night, he dotes on his favorite mascot, Pugtaro, and indulges his secret obsession with all things cute! He's kept his double life hidden for years—but one unexpected encounter turns everything upside down and forces Oji to face his feelings head-on!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.romaji: Takopii no Genzai: Arigatou, Mata Ashita

media.description: Theatrical compilation of all six episodes of the anime series Takopii no Genzai, including newly added scenes.

Akira lives a peaceful life with his older sister Haruka and his mother, who runs a cafe. The family however harbors a secret — Haruka has inherited a power from her father called "Engine," and she hides that power from others. Akira on the other hand has not inherited his father's power, and he has an inferiority complex about it. Amidst this, strange events start happening around the world.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.romaji: Diamond no Ace act II: Second Season Part 2
title.english: Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season-

media.description: Sequel to Diamond no Ace act II: Second Season.

The story of Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar follows Welsh, a teenage boy from the country who loves to cook, and Shedar, a young prince who is destined to become king one day. When the two young men with very different lives are thrown together by a chance encounter, the wheels of fate begin to turn, and soon they must work together to bring about a peaceful future by stopping a cruel despot from conquering the world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
A sequel movie to the 2014 movie Rakuen Tsuihou: Expelled From Paradise.

Misaki has often felt the urge to break free from everyday life and set out on a journey somewhere far away. Even though she doesn’t yet know what she wants to become, she longs to find something she can truly be passionate about.

At the start of a new chapter on a lively campus, she meets the members of the Railway Travel Research Club—known as the “Tetsuryo Club.” As her world unfolds along the railway lines, Misaki’s heart begins to race with excitement!

As TETSUDOU MUSUME celebrates its 20th anniversary, the Tetsuryo Club sets off on a journey through the world where the Railway Girls work, in search of moments of wonder.

(Source: Pony Canyon Anime)

title.romaji: Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen desu!

media.description:
A deep dive into the untold daily lives and the inter-school interactions of the Ooarai Girls' team and the other students (along with the colorful characters that surround them) who are wholeheartedly dedicated to the way of the tank!

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: The series had a four-part theatrical pre-screening in Japan starting in December 2025. Regular TV broadcast began in October 2026.

• Part 1 releasing theatrically on December 26, 2025.
• Part 2 releasing theatrically on January 30, 2026.
• Part 3 releasing theatrically on March 6, 2026.
• Part 4 releasing theatrically on April 10, 2026.
The fifth film in the six-part Girls und Panzer: Saishuushou film series.
The second season of Hotel Inhumans.

title.romaji: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica: prima aurora

media.description:
The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets an invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Following his grandfather’s will to “seek out the Senki,” the protagonist Kairi visits Golden Valley, a special Dark Machine economic zone. There, he meets a mysterious girl named Rudra. Dragged into becoming a Dark Machine player by Rudra, Kairi’s talent gradually blossoms over the course of many intense battles.

(Source: Fuji Creative)

Note: Part of the "DARK MACHINE" Web3 cross-media project where the story of the Game and its anime adaptation intertwine.

"Umayuru" is a short anime series featuring pint-sized Uma Musume! This time, it’s a "Full-Gate" three-minute race where *all* the Uma Musume take to the track! A super-sized, laid-back gathering with everyone!

title.romaji: Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe

media.description:
The story of Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe is set during the final stages of the Hundred Year War between Gilgamesh and Balarant that ravaged the Astragius Galaxy. Against this backdrop, army officer Maki Staufenberg is assigned to Valkyria II, the second planet in the Asgard system, where she is tasked with investigating Ash Vamps, a soldier who has earned the nickname of “Witch” because of her habit of being the sole survivor in missions assigned to her ragtag band of soldiers on punishment detail.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

Note: Relations are provisional and subject to change.

title.romaji: Kizu darake Seijo yori Houfuku wo Komete Season2
title.english: With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess Season 2

media.description: The second season of Kizu darake Seijo yori Houfuku wo Komete.

Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu’s journey—and sets history in motion.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Sergeant Keroro comes to conquer Earth, only to get captured and stuck living with the Hinata family!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.romaji: Shin Tennis no Ouji-sama: U-17 WORLD CUP Kesshou Member Ketteisen
title.english: The Prince of Tennis II U-17 WORLD CUP: Final Member Selection Match

media.description:
Old rivalries reignite as Team Japan players face off to earn spots in the lineup for the World Cup final.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)
The second half of Mahou no Shimai LuluttoLilly.

Rappa is an orphan who idolizes fictional ninja.

One snowy night, he falls from a rooftop and is saved by a real ninja named Okachimachi and his master. Rappa turns up at their door asking to become an apprentice, and the three begin living together as a family.

Years later, Rappa throws himself into training to become a ninja who can protect the town.The children who look up to him gather at the master’s traditional Japanese candy shop, a place where he can laugh with family and friends.

Rappa thinks these days will last forever, but he sees Okachimachi tending to their retired master and catches a glimpse of the pain the master has kept hidden…

(Source: BLUE RIGHTS)

Note: From a report via Anime News Network, this anime was initially announced by the studio Kinema Citrus and revealed at Anime Central 2024's "Kinema Citrus Sweet 16: My Happy Marriage and What's New" panel.

title.romaji: Maebashi Witches: Majo Minarai no Emoemories

media.description: Compilation film of Maebashi Witches.

Based on Keiko Shibata's picture book "Pan Dorobou" (Bread Thief). The picture books center on a piece of bread that also steals bread from bakeries in the city.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

Chibi shorts to Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 3rd Season released on the TOHO animation YouTube channel.

Note: Episode count begins at 49.
Note: The anime first premiered in theaters across Japan on October 2, 2026. It was later split into 3 episodes aired weekly on TV starting November 7, 2026.

title.romaji: JK Dark Summoner to Deki......Dei Nai!?
title.english: I’m Dating a Dark Summoner Omake Shorts

media.description: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on Abema.
Mini anime for Hotari no Yomeiri released on YouTube.

title.romaji: Kanojo no Tomodachi Mini Anime Gekijou

media.description: A weekly mini anime shown with each episode of Kanojo no Tomodachi exclusively on the AT-X broadcast of the TV anime and online on OceanVeil.

title.romaji: Duel Masters LOST: Danzai no Shounen

media.description: Sequel to Duel Masters LOST: Boukyaku no Taiyou.

title.romaji: Majime na Kimi ni Hamaru Karada THE ANIMATION

media.description:
After entering college, Azusa Shirakawa was enjoying campus life, marking a fresh start from her high school days, when she had devoted herself entirely to judo. But a casual joke from her childhood friend, Sae, ignited a fire within her. “Having a friends-with-benefits relationship isn't so bad, you know?” She had brushed off those words as a joke, but—her “one-time fling” with Takuma, her serious and sincere childhood friend, awakened a desire within Azusa, and her body found itself unable to resist the pleasure. Contrary to her intentions, she found herself losing control time and time again. “I never thought the day would come when I'd be getting my body in shape not for judo competitions, but for sex...” She, who was supposed to be so strong-willed, finds herself “losing” to a man. He—serious yet lecherous—begins to “corrupt” her.

(Source: Pinkpineapple, translated)
New Onegai☆Teacher anime project initiated after the 20th anniversary of the series and the closure of Lake Kizaki Capeground.

Based on the erotic game by Jitaku Studio.

Hatsune Nijo’s tastes were thoroughly warped by the influence of a childhood friend’s mother, leaving him with an intense obsession with gyaru (gal) fashion and culture. Years later, Hatsune’s fixation had only deepened—to the point where he began cross-dressing to embody his ideal gyaru persona himself. Then, one day, he received a message from his younger sister, Tsukune Nijo: "Hey, Big Bro! So, my school recently started allowing students to wear casual clothes..." "If you're still into that whole 'gal' thing, why not come to school with me?" There was no curing this twisted obsession of his. So, he decided to simply embrace it and live life on his own terms! With that resolve, Hatsune returned to his hometown and decided to transfer into the school. A new school life begins—one spent alongside gyaru girls who fully accept and celebrate his cross-dressing alter ego!

(Source: Pinkpineapple, translated)

Takeru, a married salaryman on a business trip to the countryside, meets Nazuna Tokiwa—a "gal"—through a dating app. Nazuna is a calculated "little devil" type who actively uses her charms to ensnare men. Shortly after meeting, the two engage in a passionate sexual encounter in a “sex den”—a secluded house tucked away in a remote corner of the countryside—

(Source: Showten, translated)

Kazu reunites with his childhood friend, Shion, for the first time in a long while. He falls for her all over again as he realizes she’s become even more beautiful, but despite this long-awaited reunion, she seems somehow distant… Shion is harboring a secret Kazu knows nothing about. Though Shion also harbors secret feelings for Kazu, her father, with practiced ease, runs his hands over her sensitive spots and forces her to be “friendly” with him once again today…!

(Source: Getchu, translated)

Here we go again… Yukina had come to visit her husband, who’d been injured at work, but she was dumbfounded to see him striking up conversations with every woman in sight. She ignored him and sat down on a bench in the hallway. Then, a cup of coffee was handed to her. It was from Yuto, a young man visiting his girlfriend—whom he’d met recently—and who was doting on her with a friendly, refreshing charm. For Yukina, who couldn’t help but compare him to her husband, it was just a distraction—perfect for simply watching—and she was supposed to be savoring that moment…

After seeing a flyer for a part-time job at a newly opened café, she rushed in. Standing across from her at the counter was Yuto, the man she’d met at the hospital. She was hired on the spot, and at the newly opened shop, it was just her and Yuto, the owner… For this married woman, who had devoted herself entirely to her husband, this new encounter marked the beginning of a daily life steeped in transgression—lewd, maddening, and utterly intoxicating…

(Source: Getchu, translated)

title.romaji: Ochiru Part Tsuma - Toshishita Otoko to no Jouji ni Oboreta Hate ni...

media.description:
Based on the erotic game by Studio Pork.

Sunao Saiki, who had just moved into an apartment, was a student preparing for college entrance exams. He began his new life living alone with a somber expression. However, after meeting the wife of the couple next door and being captivated by her beauty, Sunao’s new life began to brighten up. “I’m Ayano Shinonome, your neighbor. Nice to meet you.” By chance, Sunao ended up working at the same part-time job as Ayano. As Ayano kindly looked out for him both at work and in the apartment, Sunao gradually found himself drawn to her. But she was a married woman. Sunao tried to hold back, yet his feelings were impossible to suppress, and he spent his days torn by inner conflict. At the same time, Ayano, too, began to see the likeness of her first love in Sunao and started to view him as a man… The memory of a first love, the warmth of a married woman. Separated by just a single wall, a dangerous romance begins to blossom.

(Source: Getchu, translated)

title.romaji: Futanari Jinja wa Otome Ochinpo Soudansho
